name: Javelin Sergeants
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee Infantry · special · 230 leadership · T4 · Mastery
pitch: A backline javelin-thrower with exceptional hero-kill potential and poke pressure on grouped enemies. Extremely vulnerable in melee — position on elevation, throw at range, and retreat before contact; its sole counter is most other units at close range.

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Heal, more ammo (five throws, up to six with Honor-tree node); preferred post-buff. Fits playstyle of repeated throw cycles before repositioning. {2}

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Double Shot — raw damage; two separate throws feel clunky compared to the ammo efficiency of bottom-line. {2}

battleRole.positioning: Backline thrower, never lead or enter melee. Elevation extends throw range beyond the displayed red-zone — repositioning to high ground is a repeatable way to hit targets that would otherwise be out of range. {2} Throw, confirm kill or harass, retreat before the unit closes to contact. {2}
battleRole.formation: F3 (skirmish) — mandatory before using Marksman Target Throw (ability 3), or most of the volley will miss or not fire at all; F3 ensures the unit faces the target before triggering. {2}
battleRole.tips: Two targets pierced per javelin (vs Imperial Javelins' single hit), making Sergeants superior against grouped/stacked enemies. {2} AoE throw (ability 1) into targeted throw (ability 3) is the core combo — tag spread groups with AoE, then immediate targeted follow-up for rapid double damage application. {2} Ammo doctrine and bottom-line veterancy are prioritized — the +10 ammo doctrine and extra throw count directly scale kill potential before resupply. {2}

cards.name: Poke units
cards.why: great on downtime, can contest poke from backline

cards.name: Most units
cards.why: loses to most matchups at close range; vulnerable in melee

matchups.pressure: You pressure: backline ranged and grouped units; from elevation can harass targets beyond normal range. Struggles to apply pressure if forced into melee.

controls.notes: Default ability 1 (AoE throw) — targets nearest enemy in range when unit isn't facing a specific target; low setup friction for reactive poke. {2} Marksman Target Throw (ability 3) — requires F3 formation or significant portion of the volley whiffs. {2} Ammo is central to the unit — the +10 ammo doctrine and bottom-line veterancy (five throws per cycle, up to six with Honor-tree node) are close to mandatory because more throws per engagement window directly scales kill potential. {2}

gaps: Hero pairing not specified by Amya (OP left literal 'X').
Top-line vs bottom-line veterancy preference is based on a 2020 guide and pre-patch Amya edit (2026-05-26); post-2026-06-25-patch impact on the playstyle preference is unconfirmed.
